script:
node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const cp=require("node:child_process"); const git=(args)=>cp.execFileSync("git",args,{encoding:"utf8"}).trim(); const feature="acceptance-tests/features/native_bdd_handshake.feature"; const beforeCommit=git(["rev-parse","HEAD"]); const beforeTree=git(["rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"]); let text=fs.readFileSync(feature,"utf8"); const matches=text.match(/@wip/g)||[]; if(matches.length!==1) throw new Error("simulated finish requires exactly one WIP declaration"); const selected=(text.match(/@iteration-999 @wip
  Scenario: ([^
]+)/)||[])[1]; if(!selected) throw new Error("cannot identify selected synthetic scenario"); text=text.replace("@iteration-999 @wip","@iteration-999"); fs.writeFileSync(feature,text); fs.mkdirSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd",{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd/base",beforeCommit+"
"); fs.writeFileSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd/change.md","SIMULATED FINISH ONLY for "+selected+". No product implementation occurred.
"); fs.writeFileSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd/result.md","Bookkeeping-only tag transition; no scenario or app check was run.
"); fs.writeFileSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd/check.log","SIMULATED: intentionally no check execution and no green claim.
"); fs.writeFileSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd/arbitrary-driver.log","retained arbitrary log for archive proof
"); git(["add",feature]); git(["-c","user.name=Native Handshake","-c","user.email=native-handshake@example.invalid","-c","commit.gpgsign=false","commit","-m","test: simulate completed "+selected]); fs.writeFileSync(".fabro/tmp/bdd/mutation.json",JSON.stringify({phase:"simulated_finish",scenario:selected,before_commit:beforeCommit,before_tree:beforeTree,after_commit:git(["rev-parse","HEAD"]),after_tree:git(["rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"]),mutation:"Removed only the selected synthetic @wip tag; no product implementation or check."},null,2)+"
");'
